notes.title: 🚀 ToneTrek v0.75 – Major Visual Upgrade + Controller Support!
notes.content:
[p]Hello Trekkers! 🧩[/p][p]We’re excited to release [b]ToneTrek v0.75[/b], one of our biggest updates yet![/p][p]
Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][i]✨ [b]Major visual upgrades[/b] to menus and gameplay UI – smoother, clearer, more colorful.
[/i]🎮 [b]Controller support[/b] – Play with your PS or Xbox controller for a more comfortable experience.
[i]🧠 [b]6 brand-new levels[/b] added, bringing the total to [b]56 puzzles[/b]!
[/i]🐞 [b]Bug fixes[/b] and lots of [b]small improvements[/b] to make your puzzle journey smoother.
[/p][p]This version brings us one step closer to the [b]full release[/b] – we can’t wait to hear your feedback!
Thanks for playing and supporting ToneTrek 💜[/p][p][/p][p]— Dark Waters Games 🌊[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704561/52afd1268f3ac99f5873aee0625538de81ada5ef.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: v0.70 Patch – Bug Fix + Visual, Font & Sound Upgrades in Progress
notes.content: [p][b]v0.70 is here![/b] This update fixes a pesky campaign bug and brings early versions of several upgrades we’re working on.[/p][p]🛠 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where starting a new campaign could break the “Next Level” button after the first level, sending you back to the main menu or into the wrong stage. Now it correctly takes you to your rightful next challenge.[/p][/*][/list][p]🎨 [b]Visual Upgrades[/b] [i](Work in Progress)[/i][/p][list][*][p]The main menu got a partial facelift — more polish coming in future updates![/p][/*][/list][p]🔤 [b]Font Improvements[/b] [i](Work in Progress)[/i][/p][list][*][p]Added improved font rendering for non-Latin character sets (e.g., Cyrillic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Note:[/b] Some text positioning and sizing might still be off — we’re fine-tuning this in upcoming patches.[/p][/*][/list][p]🔊 [b]Menu Sounds[/b] [i](Work in Progress)[/i][/p][list][*][p]Added initial menu sound effects — these will be improved and expanded in future updates.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for your patience and feedback — keep it coming! 🚀🤖[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704561/ff96905ab588a450ebf729c5ff87d88b271b1aa6.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Improved Game Mode Selection & UI Clarity
notes.content:
We've addressed key feedback about game mode confusion and unclear navigation:
[list][*] You can now choose your Game Mode when starting a new campaign
[*] The Load menu is more descriptive
[*] Added better explanations and disclaimers in menus (e.g. how Single Level Mode works, campaign restrictions)[/list]
Thanks for the feedback — and keep it coming!

notes.title: 🛠️ Visual Upgrade Deployed!
notes.content:
[p]Our logic puzzle game just got a shiny new look!
With update [b]v0.69[/b], we’ve introduced a [b]fun, space-themed robot dashboard[/b] that frames the game in a more immersive and charming way.[/p][p]🎨 [b]What’s New?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Robotic HUD and animated interface[/p][/*][*][p]Level and move info now displayed on your new robot pals![/p][/*][*][p]Updated tile visuals and layout alignment[/p][/*][*][p]Improved readability and a more playful tone throughout the game screen[/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning — more [b]visual effects, animations, and character upgrades[/b] are coming soon![/p][p]Try it now and tell us what you think!
🧠🚀
And don’t forget — [b]Early Access[/b] is live with 40% off![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704561/34e09891527130c99bb899cbc1df54578685a581.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Features & Improvements in Development
notes.content: [p]We’re actively working on several updates to make [b]ToneTrek[/b] even better. Here’s a look at what’s planned for upcoming versions:[/p][p]🎨 [b]Visual Improvements[/b] – A refreshed UI, cleaner menus, and improved visual effects are in development to make gameplay clearer and more engaging.[/p][p]🔊 [b]Sound Enhancements[/b] – We’re upgrading the in-game audio for more satisfying and responsive sound effects.[/p][p]🎮 [b]Controller Support[/b] – Support for PlayStation, Xbox, and other gamepads is coming soon.[/p][p]📘 [b]Improved Help & Game Logic Explanations[/b] – The in-game tutorial and UI will provide clearer guidance on how to play, including controls and strategy tips.[/p][p]🍎 [b]Mac Version[/b] – A native macOS release is also on the roadmap.[/p][p]These features will be rolled out [b]gradually[/b], and [b]not in a fixed order[/b], so keep an eye on the update announcements.[/p][p]Thanks again for playing and supporting [b]ToneTrek[/b] – your feedback is what keeps the game evolving! 💜[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch v0.68 – Game Mode Selector & Russian Language Support
notes.content:
What's New:
    🧩 Game Mode Selector added – Choose your preferred game mode right when you launch the game!
    🌍 Russian language is now supported! Добро пожаловать!
    🐞 Various small improvements and bug fixes for a smoother experience.

Select your style, pick your challenge, and trek on! 🎮

notes.content:
[p]The wait is almost over — [b]ToneTrek[/b] enters [b]Early Access on August 1[/b]!
This colorful, minimalist logic puzzle game lets you change tile colors by walking on them to match clever target patterns.[/p][p]🧩 What’s included at launch:[/p][list][*][p]44 handcrafted puzzle levels[/p][/*][*][p]Campaign and single-level modes[/p][/*][*][p]New font, updated UI, and smoother menus[/p][/*][*][p]Full color scheme & tile customization[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard, mouse, and partial controller support[/p][/*][*][p]Local record tracking[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll continue improving the game based on your feedback, and the full 1.0 release is coming soon![/p][p]Try the demo now, wishlist the game, and be ready to join the Early Access launch![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3851630"][/dynamiclink][/p]
